mapper.select: SELECT stat_days.stat_date AS stat_date, IFNULL(f.gmv, 0) AS gmv, IFNULL(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, IFNULL(f.finish_order_count, 0) AS finish_order_count, IFNULL(o.cancel_order_count, 0) AS cancel_order_count, IFNULL(i.item_publish_count, 0) AS item_publish_count, IFNULL(f.finish_order_count, 0) AS item_sold_count, IFNULL(u.new_user_count, 0) AS new_user_count, IFNULL(act.active_user_count, 0) AS active_user_count, IFNULL(i.view_count, 0) AS view_count, IFNULL(fav.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, IFNULL(a.ai_call_count, 0) AS ai_call_count FROM ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(create_time) FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = '01' AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(create_time) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(create_time) FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(create_time) FROM ai_call_log WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) stat_days LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancel_order_count FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) o ON o.d = stat_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) AS d, COUNT(*) AS finish_order_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS gmv FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) ) f ON f.d = stat_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS new_user_count FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = '01' AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) u ON u.d = stat_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS item_publish_count, IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) i ON i.d = stat_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) fav ON fav.d = stat_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS ai_call_count FROM ai_call_log WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) a ON a.d = stat_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.d AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT x.user_id) AS active_user_count FROM ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, buyer_id AS user_id FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, user_id FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) x GROUP BY x.d ) act ON act.d = stat_days.stat_date ORDER BY stat_days.stat_date

SELECT funnel_days.stat_date AS stat_date, IFNULL(v.view_count, 0) AS view_count, IFNULL(f.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, IFNULL(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, IFNULL(p.pay_count, 0) AS pay_count, IFNULL(fin.finish_count, 0) AS finish_count FROM ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(create_time) FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE(create_time) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) funnel_days LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) AS view_count FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) v ON v.d = funnel_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) f ON f.d = funnel_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) o ON o.d = funnel_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(pay_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS pay_count FROM biz_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{startDate} AND pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(pay_time) ) p ON p.d = funnel_days.stat_date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) AS d, COUNT(*) AS finish_count FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(finish_time, create_time)) ) fin ON fin.d = funnel_days.stat_date ORDER BY funnel_days.stat_date

SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, MAX(p.category_name) AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS gmv FROM biz_order o JOIN biz_item i ON i.item_id = o.item_id JOIN biz_category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id JOIN biz_category p ON p.category_id = IF(c.parent_id = 0, c.category_id, c.parent_id) WHERE o.status = 2 AND COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY p.category_id ORDER BY gmv DESC

WITH activity AS ( SELECT DISTINCT buyer_id AS user_id, DATE(create_time) AS act_date FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 8 DAY) UNION SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE(create_time) FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 8 DAY) ), cohort AS ( SELECT user_id, act_date FROM activity WHERE act_date >= #{startDate} AND act_date <= #{endDate} ) SELECT c.act_date AS cohort_date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.act_date = DATE_ADD(c.act_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN c.user_id END) AS retained1, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.act_date = DATE_ADD(c.act_date, INTERVAL 3 DAY) THEN c.user_id END) AS retained3, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.act_date = DATE_ADD(c.act_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN c.user_id END) AS retained7 FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.act_date > c.act_date AND a.act_date <= DATE_ADD(c.act_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.act_date ORDER BY c.act_date

SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2) AS total_gmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order) AS total_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2) AS total_finish_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = '01' AND del_flag = '0') AS total_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0') AS total_item_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 2) AS on_sale_item_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 1) AS pending_audit_item_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_favorite) AS total_favorite_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0') AS total_view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_call_log) AS total_ai_call_count

SELECT i.item_id AS item_id, i.title AS title, i.price AS price, p.category_name AS category_name, i.status AS status, i.view_count AS view_count, i.favorite_count AS favorite_count, IFNULL(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count, IFNULL(o.gmv, 0) AS gmv FROM biz_item i LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN biz_category p ON p.category_id = IF(c.parent_id = 0, c.category_id, c.parent_id) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT item_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS gmv FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 GROUP BY item_id ) o ON o.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY (i.view_count + i.favorite_count * 3) DESC, gmv DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.seller_id AS seller_id, u.nickname AS nickname, d.dept_name AS dept_name, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, IFNULL(cm.cnt, 0) AS comment_count, IFNULL(cm.good, 0) AS good_count FROM biz_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = o.seller_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT to_user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good FROM biz_comment WHERE status = '0' GROUP BY to_user_id ) cm ON cm.to_user_id = o.seller_id WHERE o.status = 2 GROUP BY o.seller_id, u.nickname, d.dept_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT scene AS scene, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fallback_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_count, IFNULL(AVG(cost_ms), 0) AS avg_cost_ms, IFNULL(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens FROM ai_call_log WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY scene ORDER BY call_count DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS finish_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM biz_order WHERE status = 2 AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(finish_time, create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS order_gmv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{startDate} AND pay_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS pay_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_favorite WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS favorite_count, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_call_log WHERE create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS ai_call_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE user_type = '01' AND del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS new_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS item_publish_count

SELECT DATE(COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time)) AS stat_date, p.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS gmv FROM biz_order o JOIN biz_item i ON i.item_id = o.item_id JOIN biz_category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id JOIN biz_category p ON p.category_id = IF(c.parent_id = 0, c.category_id, c.parent_id) WHERE o.status = 2 AND COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time) >= #{startDate} AND COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time)), p.category_id ORDER BY stat_date, p.category_id

SELECT DATE(i.create_time) AS stat_date, p.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM biz_item i JOIN biz_category c ON c.category_id = i.category_id JOIN biz_category p ON p.category_id = IF(c.parent_id = 0, c.category_id, c.parent_id) WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.create_time >= #{startDate} AND i.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(i.create_time), p.category_id ORDER BY stat_date, p.category_id

SELECT o.order_no AS order_no, i.title AS item_title, o.amount AS amount, bu.nickname AS buyer_nickname, su.nickname AS seller_nickname, COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.update_time) AS finish_time FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN biz_item i ON i.item_id = o.item_id LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON bu.user_id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = o.seller_id WHERE o.status = 2 ORDER BY COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.update_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.order_no AS order_no, i.title AS item_title, bu.nickname AS buyer_name, su.nickname AS seller_name, o.amount AS amount, o.status AS status, o.create_time AS create_time, o.finish_time AS finish_time, o.trade_place AS trade_place FROM biz_order o LEFT JOIN biz_item i ON i.item_id = o.item_id LEFT JOIN sys_user bu ON bu.user_id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = o.seller_id WHERE o.create_time >= #{startDate} AND o.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT stat_date, gmv, order_count, finish_order_count, cancel_order_count, item_publish_count, item_sold_count, new_user_count, active_user_count, view_count, favorite_count, ai_call_count FROM stat_overview_daily WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT stat_date, view_count, favorite_count, order_count, pay_count, finish_count FROM stat_funnel_daily WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT s.category_id AS category_id, MAX(c.category_name) AS category_name, IFNULL(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS order_count, IFNULL(SUM(s.gmv), 0) AS gmv FROM stat_category_daily s LEFT JOIN biz_category c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE s.stat_date >= #{startDate} AND s.stat_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY s.category_id ORDER BY gmv DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stat_date) FROM stat_category_daily WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date <= #{endDate}

mapper.select: WITH rfm AS ( SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, d.dept_name AS dept_name, IFNULL(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MAX(DATE(COALESCE(o.finish_time, o.create_time)))), 999) AS recency_days, COUNT(o.order_id) AS frequency, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS monetary FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN biz_order o ON o.buyer_id = u.user_id AND o.status = 2 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.user_type = '01' AND u.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname, d.dept_name ) SELECT r.user_id, r.nickname, r.dept_name, r.recency_days, r.frequency, r.monetary, CAST(6 - NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY r.recency_days ASC) AS SIGNED) AS r_score, CAST(NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY r.frequency ASC) AS SIGNED) AS f_score, CAST(NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY r.monetary ASC) AS SIGNED) AS m_score FROM rfm r WHERE r.frequency > 0 ORDER BY r.monetary DESC, r.frequency DESC, r.user_id ASC
SELECT NULL AS user_id, NULL AS nickname, NULL AS dept_name, 999 AS recency_days, 0 AS frequency, 0 AS monetary, 1 AS r_score, 1 AS f_score, 1 AS m_score

SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, u.nickname AS nickname, d.dept_name AS dept_name, 999 AS recency_days, 0 AS frequency, 0 AS monetary FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.user_type = '01' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_order o WHERE o.buyer_id = u.user_id AND o.status = 2) ORDER BY u.user_id

INSERT INTO stat_user_rfm (user_id, recency_days, frequency, monetary, r_score, f_score, m_score, segment, calc_date) VALUES
(#{it.userId}, #{it.recencyDays}, #{it.frequency}, #{it.monetary}, #{it.rScore}, #{it.fScore}, #{it.mScore}, #{it.segment}, #{it.calcDate})
mapper.sql: SELECT segment AS segment, COUNT(*) AS user_count, IFNULL(SUM(monetary), 0) AS monetary FROM stat_user_rfm WHERE calc_date = #{calcDate} GROUP BY segment ORDER BY user_count DESC
